verdict.reasons: The single white-and-blue upright cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll matches the reference and required product family. The main AFP mark, water-drop symbol, English 'Drip Irrigation Tape' caption, and Persian brand text are authentic, readable, and coherently wrapped around the cylinder. The legitimate AFP | 09134922013 watermark is present. Installed thin flattened laterals and localized root-zone wetting are consistent with drip-tape agronomy. No wrong hose-family package, people, collage, or contradictory crop is present. Minor advisory issues only: the package rests directly on the soil without a distinct clearance gap, but this does not make it plumbing hardware or reduce core recognizability. Detail crops show the same object, not extra products.

focused_physical_review.reason: One required white-and-blue AFP carton sits upright on bare soil; its footprint is fully visible and not obstructed. The black drip lines and green seedling rows are offset laterally to the right, with a broad uninterrupted band of bare soil around the package base, including behind it (no line emerges from, touches, or passes behind the carton on the same axis). No distinct additional uninstalled coil/roll is present—the visible lines are continuous installed laterals, and the roll inside the carton is not counted. No white ribbon, strap, or tape tail protrudes from the carton sides or base; the blue lower band is part of the packaging, not an emerging strip.
